scope: All staged files exported via git checkout-index. No dependencies/build caches/submodule contents or user AD-064 file/README link. This scan and triage output and later publication metadata were generated afterward and are not claimed to scan themselves.
method: Read every finding span in exact exported source. Classify explicit filename-keyed source/artifact SHA-256 digests and 20-byte EVM addresses in public contract/account/token data. No suppression or allowlist; raw exit 1 preserved. Pattern scan is not proof of absence of every credential.
